title: Sean McVay not sure if Puka Nacua will play vs. Broncos on Sunday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay not sure if Puka Nacua will play vs. Broncos on Sunday
sources.description: Rams coach Sean McVay is hopeful star wide receiver Puka Nacua will be available to play against Denver, but isn't sure if that will happen.
